rows.en: <operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>Before we deploy, please say a word to everyone.
<operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>Um... since some of you I'm meeting for the first time, let me introduce myself.
<operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>Pilot of the <color(4)>Nanajin<ce()>, <color(4)>Asap Suzuki<ce()>.
rows.notes: 'Nanajin no pilot, Asap Suzuki desu' reordered to keep the two color-tagged terms in source order rather than the usual English self-intro order.

rows.en: <operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>I was sent from the present day to Byston Well... and came back to the surface together with King <color(5)>Sakomizu<ce()>.
<operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>Since I came back to the surface, Commander <color(4)>Misumaru<ce()> has protected me, but I've decided to help everyone.
rows.notes: Orchestrator: shortened to fit three lines.

rows.en: <operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>Commander <color(4)>Misumaru<ce()> was against it, but we bear some responsibility for this too. I want to stop King <color(5)>Sakomizu<ce()>.
<operator(16040,1)><speed(2)>My father was driven to despair by how much the surface world, his homeland, had changed.
<operator(16040,1)><speed(2)>And now, believing he must destroy today's surface and build a new world, he's attacking it.
<operator(16040,1)><speed(2)>Right now my father is possessed by delusion. Please, lend us your strength.
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>Of course. This is our problem too.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Still, though. Something about this doesn't sit right with me at all!
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Even with these so-called Holy Warriors attacking, is it really okay to simply leave 5th Luna alone?
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>They've got the <color(4)>Ra Cailum<ce()> over there. We simply have to trust <color(4)>Bright<ce()>.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>You're right. Let's do what we can do.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>Once we've stopped the <color(5)>Sakomizu army<ce()>, let's head straight to reinforce them.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>, you look listless. This is an important part, so get your head in the game.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...I know. Quit talking to me like you're my guardian!
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>...Fine, as long as you know.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Ah... sorry. I can't help thinking about him...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Sorry for nagging you too.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Amuro<ce()>, you fought a guy named <color(5)>Char<ce()> back in the day, right? What kind of person was he?
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>...A sharp man. No, a man who's too sharp. He thinks about too many things.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>That's probably why he can't stand the way the world is now.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>If <color(4)>Amuro<ce()> says so, he must really be something.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Prioritizing their own safety over the whole Earth, huh. Big shots are hopeless.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Makes you feel kind of... empty, being a soldier.
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>Huh?!
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Wh-whaaat!?
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>D-did I say something wrong!?
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>Nah. What you're saying actually makes sense, I think?
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Kaine<ce()>, saying something that sensible...
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Y-y-you guys, I swear...!!
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>What's up with old man <color(4)>Misumaru<ce()>? That wishy-washy attitude!
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Where'd all that pointless bravado of his go, huh?
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>Can't be helped. He has to pass down orders he can't make sense of himself.
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>Though someone like you probably wouldn't get that.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Fine by me if I don't get it! Fighting's what I'm suited for anyway!
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>, aren't you scared?
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>I'm all right.
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>Can't say I feel the same. Not with a plan like this.
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... I've got a bad feeling about this.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>It's all right.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>I can sense a great light... A very warm light...
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>It will protect us.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>An Aura Battler... how does it even move?
<operator(12091,1)><speed(2)>Artificial skeleton, Byston Well creature muscle for the frame, crustacean shell for the armor.
rows.notes: Long 3-line source row compressed to fit the 120-char visible limit; full meaning (artificial skeleton, Byston Well creature muscle, crustacean-shell armor) kept.

rows.en: <operator(12091,1)><speed(2)>So it has a mechanism that's almost organic enough to call it a living thing.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Is <color(5)>Char<ce()> really that strong? <color(4)>Amuro<ce()> gets so fired up whenever it comes to him.
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>They're rivals, apparently. Sounds like there's a lot of history between them too.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>So basically... he fought <color(4)>Amuro<ce()> for the throne. Sounds like a real terrifying opponent.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>Basically we need to finish this fast and go take care of <color(5)>Char<ce()>, right?
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>Like it's gonna be that easy. This is why people call you simple-minded!
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>What!? Who're you calling simple-minded!
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>We can't afford to underestimate them.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>Ugh...
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>See, told you!
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>Still, if you ask me which is the bigger threat right now... I'd have to say <color(5)>Neo Zeon<ce()>.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>See, told you!
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>So... I'll take down both of them.
<operator(16040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Asap<ce()>, please be careful.
<operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>I'll be fine, <color(4)>Luxe<ce()>.

uncertainties.issue: Long source row (3 lines) compressed to fit the 120-char visible limit; full meaning kept (artificial skeleton, Byston Well creature muscle for structure, crustacean shell for armor).

meaning_fixes.before: Before we deploy, could I get a word from everyone.
meaning_fixes.after: Before we deploy, please say a word to everyone.
meaning_fixes.reason: reversed direction of the request: source ('minasan e hitokoto onegai shimasu') has Ruri asking someone (Asap, who speaks next and introduces himself) to say a word TO everyone, not asking to receive a word FROM everyone; the old phrasing had Ruri as the recipient instead of the person being invited to speak.

checked_decisions: Table 0 slot 19-24: Ruri's opening line corrected (see meaning_fixes); confirmed by Asap's reply ('let me introduce myself') which only makes sense if Ruri asked him, not the reverse.
Table 0 slot 21: 'Nanajin' kept as the locked exception name (contains j, per project rule that locked names like Nanajin are the accepted exception to the no-lowercase-j/q rule).
Table 1 slot 220-221: long 3-line source row compressed to fit the 120-char limit; all three elements (artificial skeleton, Byston Well creature muscle, crustacean-shell armor) kept. Accepted.

Table 1 slot 261-262: 'sugoi aite' (lit. 'amazing/formidable opponent') rendered 'a real terrifying opponent'; kept - 'terrifying' is a standard English rendering for a formidable combat opponent and matches Gainer's awed-but-wary tone toward Char.

Names verified against glossary: Char Aznable/Char, Ra Cailum, Bright, Neo Zeon, Amuro, Asap Suzuki, Luxe Sakomizu, King Sakomizu, Tiffa Adill/Tiffa, Nanajin, Holy Warrior(s), Sakomizu army - all match character_names_021.json/glossary.json.
'5th Luna' kept in digit form, mirroring the source's own fullwidth-digit romanized formatting; no glossary entry exists to confirm an alternate spelling (e.g. 'Fifth Luna').
Commander Misumaru's title kept as 'Commander' (not 'Captain'), consistent with corpus precedent (4004403) and distinct from the orchestrator's 'Captain' ruling for Amuro/ship captains.
Full scan for lowercase j/q outside locked names: 6 rows reworded (all lowercase j); 'Nanajin' correctly left as the locked exception. No lowercase q found.
remaining_uncertainties: Table 1 slot 220: the compressed rendering of Inez's 3-line technical explanation is a paraphrase for length; all factual content is kept but the phrasing is condensed.
'5th Luna' spelling is unconfirmed by any glossary source; kept as a literal, source-faithful transliteration.
